iconicAnchor.label: Swiss photo-type poster construction
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Müller-Brockmann's poster holdings establish disciplined modernist integration of photography, sans typography, crop, and grid.

sources.title: Josef Müller-Brockmann
supports: MoMA's holdings include photo-led exhibition and cultural posters within Müller-Brockmann's modernist practice.
The body of work supports strict integration rather than generic text laid over an image.

sources.title: Dariush Borbor Graphic Design, Poster, Tehran, 2018
supports: The audited author-released poster provides lawful contextual evidence of photographic and typographic construction.
The audit also shows that this reference is not canonical enough to lead the final set.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches photo type integration, strict grid, hard crop, oversized type, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/swiss-phototypography/generated-01.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
